# [Baseline] - WIN - D - Shared Devices SharePoint Team Sites

Syncs one SharePoint library of the customer automatically for every user on shared devices, as online-only files, so that everyone has the shared folder in Explorer without adding it themselves.

| | |
|---|---|
| Platform | Windows |
| Scope | Device (D) — assign to device groups |
| Type | Settings Catalog |
| Assignment | — |
| Source | Own baseline — Configure team site libraries to sync automatically (AutoMountTeamSites, Microsoft Learn: Use OneDrive policies to control sync settings). Name and library ID from the CIPP variables %SharedTeamSiteName% and %SharedTeamSiteLibraryId%. |
| File | [`Baseline_WIN_D_Shared_Devices_SharePoint_Team_Sites.json`](Baseline_WIN_D_Shared_Devices_SharePoint_Team_Sites.json) |

> Belongs on SG-D-UEM-WIN-Shared, together with [Baseline] - WIN - D - Shared Devices OneDrive (Files On-Demand is required). Set the variables %SharedTeamSiteName% (the name in Explorer) and %SharedTeamSiteLibraryId% per tenant in CIPP. Get the library ID in SharePoint: open the library, Sync, cancel the OneDrive prompt and choose Copy library ID. Microsoft advises against it for libraries with more than 5,000 files or folders and for more than 1,000 devices per library. OneDrive mounts the library within eight hours after sign-in; on a shared device with ever new profiles a user may therefore have to wait for it the first time. The Settings Catalog IDs follow the pattern of the other OneDrive settings and are not literally in any source: if CIPP rejects the template, take the IDs from the Settings Catalog (Configure team site libraries to sync automatically).
